description: Document your life to keep you in control and your vision focused. #fyp #careeradvice #lifebydesign #IntentionalLiving #leadershipdevelopment
transcript: document everything, document the interactions that you have at work, good or bad, document everything, document interactions that you have with your family, your friends, your significant others, document how you reacted. Do this without judgment. It allows you the capacity to refer back to information when you can visually see what's going on, how you are handling situations, how others are handling situations with you. You can take action. When you keep that all in your head, you keep up with routines and structures that may not be good for you. When you document, you allow yourself the capacity to see what's going on and how to take action.
